### `quote` — real-time quote for one or more symbols
### `depth` — Level 2 order book (bid/ask ladder)
### `brokers` — broker queue at each price level (HK only)
### `trades` — recent tick-by-tick trades
### `intraday` — intraday minute-by-minute price and volume
### `kline` — OHLCV candlestick data or historical date-range
### `static` — static reference info (name, listing exchange, lot size, etc.)
### `calc-index` — calculated indexes (PE, PB, turnover rate, DPS rate)
### `capital` — intraday capital distribution or flow time series
### `market-temp` — market sentiment index (0–100)
### `trading` — trading session schedule and trading calendar
### `security-list` — overnight-eligible securities by market
### `participants` — market maker broker IDs and names
### `subscriptions` — active real-time WebSocket subscriptions
### `ah-premium` — A/H premium ratio for dual-listed stocks
### `trade-stats` — price distribution by volume (intraday profile)
### `market-status` — market open/close status for each exchange
### `exchange-rate` — exchange rates for all supported currencies
### `ipo` — IPO commands: calendar, subscriptions, us-subscriptions, orders, profit-loss

content.value_statement: Market questions often require several Longbridge commands and careful symbol formatting. This skill routes requests, collects the right data, and returns concise market summaries.
actual_capabilities: Guide quote, static, valuation, K-line, intraday, depth, trade, and capital flow lookups.
Normalize common HK, US, A-share, and Singapore symbols before data requests.
Use JSON output from Longbridge CLI commands and describe results in the user's language.
Summarize market temperature, trading sessions, exchange rates, and IPO calendar data.
Support A/H premium, ADR premium, and FX carry analysis workflows.
Fallback to Longbridge MCP when local CLI access is unavailable for supported topics.
limitations: Requires Longbridge CLI or Longbridge MCP access for live data.
Account-specific IPO orders, profit and loss, and subscriptions may require login.
Security lists are limited to supported Longbridge endpoints and markets.
It provides market data analysis, not investment advice or trade execution.

use_cases.title: Check Market Snapshots
use_cases.description: Check current quotes, chart context, trading sessions, and IPO calendars before researching a position.

use_cases.title: Compare Liquidity Signals
use_cases.description: Compare order book depth, recent trades, capital flow, and premium spreads across supported markets.

use_cases.title: Build AI Market Workflows
use_cases.description: Add Longbridge market data routing to Claude, Codex, or Claude Code workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Quote
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the latest quote for NVDA.US with price change, volume, and data source.

prompt_templates.title: Review Intraday Activity
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze today's intraday trend, capital flow, and latest trades for 700.HK. Mention off-hours limits if relevant.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Cross-Market Premium
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare BABA.US and 9988.HK using live quotes and exchange rates. Explain the ADR premium and practical constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Assess FX Carry Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate AUD/JPY, NZD/USD, and MXN/JPY carry trades using current rates, volatility context, and tail-risk scenarios.

output_examples.input: What is the latest quote for AAPL.US?
output_examples.output: A concise quote summary with last price, change, volume, trade status, and Longbridge Securities as the data source.

output_examples.input: Is the Hong Kong market open today?
output_examples.output: A session summary that explains open or closed status, local market time, and any calendar notes returned by Longbridge.

output_examples.input: Compare Alibaba ADR and HK shares.
output_examples.output: A premium analysis with local prices, currency conversion, spread direction, and notes on liquidity, settlement, and FX constraints.

best_practices: Confirm ambiguous symbols or markets before requesting data.
Use JSON output from Longbridge commands when the agent will parse results.
State the data source and session context in every market summary.
anti_patterns: Do not treat stale off-hours depth or trades as live activity.
Do not dump full security or participant lists when a count or lookup answers the request.
Do not present market data summaries as personalized investment advice.

faq.question: Which markets does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Longbridge-supported HK, US, A-share, and Singapore market data where the endpoint supports them.

faq.question: Does it require a Longbridge login?
faq.answer: Most public market data commands do not require login. Account-specific subscriptions, IPO orders, and profit and loss can require login.

faq.question: Can it place trades?
faq.answer: No. The skill is designed for data retrieval and analysis, not order placement.

faq.question: Can it work without the local CLI?
faq.answer: Some workflows can use Longbridge MCP as a fallback when the CLI is unavailable.

faq.question: Does it provide investment advice?
faq.answer: No. It summarizes market data and risk context for the user to evaluate.

faq.question: Can it analyze premium spreads?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes A/H premium, ADR premium, and FX carry workflows using quotes and exchange rates.
